name: taste-skill
tagline_zh: 受够了AI的“正确废话”？装上它，AI自动避开陈词滥调，输出带人味、有质感的文字——像有个毒舌编辑在后台把关。
tagline_en: Tired of AI's generic fluff? This skill filters out clichés, giving you sharp, human-flavored writing—like a.
desc_en: Gives your AI good taste. Stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop
why_zh: 同类工具只查语法，它直接扫描“无聊模式”——从词汇到句式，专杀八股腔，且可调挑剔度。
why_en: Unlike grammar checkers, it detects 'boring patterns'—kills clichés and stiff phrasing, with adjustable snark level.
